name: paperclip-sandbox-hardening-repo
description: Sandbox hardening for Paperclip agent runs: a Paperclip plugin with one switch per protection, Agent boxes with daily token caps, a self-test, and one-line installers for a separate-user watchdog and the Hermes sandbox wrapper.
